passages.text: This is the word of the LORD that came to Zephaniah son of Cushi, the son of Gedaliah, the son of Amariah, the son of Hezekiah, in the days of Josiah son of Amon king of Judah: “I will completely sweep away everything from the face of the earth,” declares the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Zephaniah.
Zephaniah was the son of Cushi.
Cushi was the son of Gedaliah.
Gedaliah was the son of Amariah.
Amariah was the son of Hezekiah.
This happened during the days of Josiah.
Josiah was the son of Amon.
Josiah was king of Judah.
The LORD said, “I will sweep away everything from the face of the earth.”
The LORD declared this.
passages.original: דְּבַר־ יְהוָ֣ה׀ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָיָ֗ה אֶל־ צְפַנְיָה֙ בֶּן־ כּוּשִׁ֣י בֶן־ גְּדַלְיָ֔ה בֶּן־ אֲמַרְיָ֖ה בֶּן־ חִזְקִיָּ֑ה בִּימֵ֛י יֹאשִׁיָּ֥הוּ בֶן־ אָמ֖וֹן מֶ֥לֶךְ יְהוּדָֽה׃ אָסֹ֨ף אָסֵ֜ף כֹּ֗ל מֵעַ֛ל פְּנֵ֥י הָאֲדָמָ֖ה נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: “I will sweep away man and beast; I will sweep away the birds of the air, and the fish of the sea, and the idols with their wicked worshipers. I will cut off mankind from the face of the earth,” declares the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks.
The LORD will sweep away man.
The LORD will sweep away beast.
The LORD will sweep away the birds of the air.
The LORD will sweep away the fish of the sea.
The LORD will sweep away the idols.
The LORD will sweep away the wicked worshipers of idols.
The LORD will cut off mankind from the face of the earth.
passages.original: אָסֵ֨ף אָדָ֜ם וּבְהֵמָ֗ה אָסֵ֤ף עוֹף־ הַשָּׁמַ֙יִם֙ וּדְגֵ֣י הַיָּ֔ם וְהַמַּכְשֵׁל֖וֹת אֶת־ הָרְשָׁעִ֑ים וְהִכְרַתִּ֣י אֶת־ הָאָדָ֗ם מֵעַ֛ל פְּנֵ֥י הָאֲדָמָ֖ה נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: “I will stretch out My hand against Judah and against all who dwell in Jerusalem. I will cut off from this place every remnant of Baal, the names of the idolatrous and pagan priests— those who bow on the rooftops to worship the host of heaven, those who bow down and swear by the LORD but also swear by Milcom, and those who turn back from following the LORD, neither seeking the LORD nor inquiring of Him.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Zephaniah during the days of Josiah, king of Judah.
The LORD said, “I will stretch out My hand against Judah.
I will act against all who live in Jerusalem.
I will remove every remnant of Baal from this place.
I will cut off the names of the idolatrous priests.
I will remove the pagan priests.
I will judge those who bow down on the rooftops to worship the stars in the sky.
I will judge those who bow down and swear by the LORD but also swear by Milcom.
I will judge those who turn away from following the LORD.
I will judge those who do not seek the LORD.
I will judge those who do not ask for Him.”
passages.original: וְנָטִ֤יתִי יָדִי֙ עַל־ יְהוּדָ֔ה וְעַ֖ל כָּל־ יוֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְהִכְרַתִּ֞י מִן־ הַמָּק֤וֹם הַזֶּה֙ אֶת־ שְׁאָ֣ר הַבַּ֔עַל אֶת־ שֵׁ֥ם הַכְּמָרִ֖ים עִם־ הַכֹּהֲנִֽים׃ וְאֶת־ הַמִּשְׁתַּחֲוִ֥ים עַל־ הַגַּגּ֖וֹת לִצְבָ֣א הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם וְאֶת־ הַמִּֽשְׁתַּחֲוִים֙ הַנִּשְׁבָּעִ֣ים לַֽיהוָ֔ה וְהַנִּשְׁבָּעִ֖ים בְּמַלְכָּֽם׃ וְאֶת־ הַנְּסוֹגִ֖ים מֵאַחֲרֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַאֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹֽא־ בִקְשׁ֥וּ אֶת־ יְהוָ֖ה וְלֹ֥א דְרָשֻֽׁהוּ׃

passages.text: Be silent in the presence of the Lord GOD, for the Day of the LORD is near. Indeed, the LORD has prepared a sacrifice; He has consecrated His guests.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD is present.
The Day of the LORD is near.
Be silent before Him.
The LORD has prepared a sacrifice.
He has set apart His guests.
passages.original: הַ֕ס מִפְּנֵ֖י אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה כִּ֤י קָרוֹב֙ י֣וֹם יְהוָ֔ה כִּֽי־ הֵכִ֧ין יְהוָ֛ה זֶ֖בַח הִקְדִּ֥ישׁ קְרֻאָֽיו׃

passages.text: “On the Day of the LORD’s sacrifice I will punish the princes, the sons of the king, and all who are dressed in foreign apparel.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD will act on the Day of His sacrifice.
On that day, the LORD will punish certain people.
The LORD will punish the princes.
The LORD will punish the sons of the king.
The LORD will punish all who wear foreign clothes.
passages.original: וְהָיָ֗ה בְּיוֹם֙ זֶ֣בַח יְהוָ֔ה וּפָקַדְתִּ֥י עַל־ הַשָּׂרִ֖ים וְעַל־ בְּנֵ֣י הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וְעַ֥ל כָּל־ הַלֹּבְשִׁ֖ים מַלְבּ֥וּשׁ נָכְרִֽי׃

passages.text: On that day I will punish all who leap over the threshold, who fill the house of their master with violence and deceit.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks about the Day of the LORD.
On that day, the LORD will punish certain people.
These people leap over the threshold.
They fill their master's house with violence.
They fill their master's house with deceit.
passages.original: וּפָקַדְתִּ֗י עַ֧ל כָּל־ הַדּוֹלֵ֛ג עַל־ הַמִּפְתָּ֖ן בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֑וּא הַֽמְמַלְאִ֛ים בֵּ֥ית אֲדֹנֵיהֶ֖ם חָמָ֥ס וּמִרְמָֽה׃ס

passages.text: On that day,” declares the LORD, “a cry will go up from the Fish Gate, a wail from the Second District, and a loud crashing from the hills.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks about a coming day.
On that day, the LORD will act.
A loud cry will come from the Fish Gate.
A wail will rise from the Second District.
A great crashing sound will come from the hills.
passages.original: וְהָיָה֩ בַיּ֨וֹם הַה֜וּא נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֗ה ק֤וֹל צְעָקָה֙ מִשַּׁ֣עַר הַדָּגִ֔ים וִֽילָלָ֖ה מִן־ הַמִּשְׁנֶ֑ה וְשֶׁ֥בֶר גָּד֖וֹל מֵהַגְּבָעֽוֹת׃

passages.text: Wail, O dwellers of the Hollow, for all your merchants will be silenced; all who weigh out silver will be cut off.
passages.sermon:
The people who live in the Hollow must cry out.
God commands them to wail.
All the merchants will become silent.
God will destroy everyone who trades in silver.
No one who weighs out silver will remain.
passages.original: הֵילִ֖ילוּ יֹשְׁבֵ֣י הַמַּכְתֵּ֑שׁ כִּ֤י נִדְמָה֙ כָּל־ עַ֣ם כְּנַ֔עַן נִכְרְת֖וּ כָּל־ נְטִ֥ילֵי כָֽסֶף׃

passages.text: And at that time I will search Jerusalem with lamps and punish the men settled in complacency, who say to themselves, ‘The LORD will do nothing, either good or bad.’
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks.
He will act at a certain time.
He will search Jerusalem.
He will use lamps to look everywhere.
He will find the people who live there.
Some people are settled and comfortable.
They do not care about what is right.
They say in their hearts, “The LORD will not do good.”
They also say, “The LORD will not do harm.”
The LORD will punish these people.
passages.original: וְהָיָה֙ בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֔יא אֲחַפֵּ֥שׂ אֶת־ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם בַּנֵּר֑וֹת וּפָקַדְתִּ֣י עַל־ הָאֲנָשִׁ֗ים הַקֹּֽפְאִים֙ עַל־ שִׁמְרֵיהֶ֔ם הָאֹֽמְרִים֙ בִּלְבָבָ֔ם לֹֽא־ יֵיטִ֥יב יְהוָ֖ה וְלֹ֥א יָרֵֽעַ׃

passages.text: Their wealth will be plundered and their houses laid waste. They will build houses but not inhabit them, and plant vineyards but never drink their wine.
passages.sermon:
God will judge the people of Jerusalem.
He will take away their wealth.
Enemies will plunder their riches.
Their houses will become empty and ruined.
They will build new houses.
But they will not live in them.
They will plant vineyards.
But they will not drink the wine from them.
passages.original: וְהָיָ֤ה חֵילָם֙ לִמְשִׁסָּ֔ה וּבָתֵּיהֶ֖ם לִשְׁמָמָ֑ה וּבָנ֤וּ בָתִּים֙ וְלֹ֣א יֵשֵׁ֔בוּ וְנָטְע֣וּ כְרָמִ֔ים וְלֹ֥א יִשְׁתּ֖וּ אֶת־ יֵינָֽם׃

passages.text: The great Day of the LORD is near— near and coming quickly. Listen, the Day of the LORD! Then the cry of the mighty will be bitter.
passages.sermon:
The Day of the LORD is great.
This day is near.
It is coming very soon.
The Day of the LORD will arrive quickly.
On that day, people will hear a loud cry.
The cry will be bitter.
Even the strong and mighty will cry out in pain.
passages.original: קָר֤וֹב יוֹם־ יְהוָה֙ הַגָּד֔וֹל קָר֖וֹב וּמַהֵ֣ר מְאֹ֑ד ק֚וֹל י֣וֹם יְהוָ֔ה מַ֥ר צֹרֵ֖חַ שָׁ֥ם גִּבּֽוֹר׃

passages.text: That day will be a day of wrath, a day of trouble and distress, a day of destruction and desolation, a day of darkness and gloom, a day of clouds and blackness, a day of horn blast and battle cry against the fortified cities, and against the high corner towers.
passages.sermon:
The Day of the LORD is coming.
This day will be a day of wrath.
It will be a day of trouble.
It will be a day of distress.
It will be a day of destruction.
It will be a day of desolation.
It will be a day of darkness.
It will be a day of gloom.
It will be a day of clouds.
It will be a day of blackness.
On this day, people will hear the blast of the horn.
They will hear the battle cry.
These sounds will come against the fortified cities.
They will come against the high corner towers.
passages.original: י֥וֹם עֶבְרָ֖ה הַיּ֣וֹם הַה֑וּא י֧וֹם צָרָ֣ה וּמְצוּקָ֗ה י֤וֹם שֹׁאָה֙ וּמְשׁוֹאָ֔ה י֥וֹם חֹ֙שֶׁךְ֙ וַאֲפֵלָ֔ה י֥וֹם עָנָ֖ן וַעֲרָפֶֽל׃ י֥וֹם שׁוֹפָ֖ר וּתְרוּעָ֑ה עַ֚ל הֶעָרִ֣ים הַבְּצֻר֔וֹת וְעַ֖ל הַפִּנּ֥וֹת הַגְּבֹהֽוֹת׃

passages.text: I will bring such distress on mankind that they will walk like the blind, because they have sinned against the LORD. Their blood will be poured out like dust and their flesh like dung.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is holy and just.
Mankind has sinned against the LORD.
I will bring great distress on mankind.
People will walk like blind men.
They will not see the way.
Their blood will pour out like dust.
Their flesh will be like dung.
passages.original: וַהֲצֵרֹ֣תִי לָאָדָ֗ם וְהָֽלְכוּ֙ כַּֽעִוְרִ֔ים כִּ֥י לַֽיהוָ֖ה חָטָ֑אוּ וְשֻׁפַּ֤ךְ דָּמָם֙ כֶּֽעָפָ֔ר וּלְחֻמָ֖ם כַּגְּלָלִֽים׃

passages.text: Neither their silver nor their gold will be able to deliver them on the Day of the LORD’s wrath. The whole earth will be consumed by the fire of His jealousy.” For indeed, He will make a sudden end of all who dwell on the earth.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is a God of wrath and jealousy.
On the Day of the LORD’s wrath, people will face His anger.
No one can save themselves with silver.
No one can save themselves with gold.
Money and wealth will not deliver anyone.
The fire of the LORD’s jealousy will consume the whole earth.
He will destroy all who live on the earth suddenly.
No one will escape His judgment.
passages.original: גַּם־ כַּסְפָּ֨ם גַּם־ זְהָבָ֜ם לֹֽא־ יוּכַ֣ל לְהַצִּילָ֗ם בְּיוֹם֙ עֶבְרַ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה וּבְאֵשׁ֙ קִנְאָת֔וֹ תֵּאָכֵ֖ל כָּל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ כִּֽי־ כָלָ֤ה אַךְ־ נִבְהָלָה֙ יַֽעֲשֶׂ֔ה אֵ֥ת כָּל־ יֹשְׁבֵ֖י הָאָֽרֶץ׃ס
